wait_for_guest_agent_info.description: Wait time in seconds for guest agent to be ready

ipaddress.description: IP address assigned to nic. For this attribute to be set, `assign_ip_address` must be set to `true` and vent id should be set to an Internal Vnet.

category_filter.description: Filter tags by category ID (optional). Use with `filter` to uniquely identify tags with duplicate names across categories.

category_name.description: Filter tags by category name (optional). Alternative to `category_filter` when you know the category name but not the ID. Cannot be used together with `category_filter`.

filter.description: Filter tags by name (optional). If provided, only tags with matching names will be returned.

block.description: Tags data source to retrieve tag information from VergeOS. Supports filtering by name and/or category to handle duplicate tag names across categories.
